questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and be ready to stop at the intersection. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane for left turns only. You cannot use this lane for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. Come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and other vehicles. Wait until the intersection is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead and you should be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns of a sharp turn ahead and tells you to reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it to their side, it signals riders to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black markings. It tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead. You should prepare to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This is a construction sign. It is orange with black markings. It warns you that you are approaching a work zone. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show the direction the road curves. The arrow points left, so the road curves sharply to the left. You may see several of these signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves right ahead. The number shows the safe speed for the curve. Slow down to that speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. It warns you that the separated lanes are ending and two-way traffic is about to begin.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is unsafe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black markings. It warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and keep more distance between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead splits into two one-way lanes separated by a median. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic signals are arranged in a set order. On vertical signals, red is on top and green is on bottom. On horizontal signals, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers and riders can use hand signals instead of turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight to the side, it means the driver plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride along the road. Drive carefully in this area because cyclists regularly use it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way lanes with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming dangers. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is becoming narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers and riders can use hand signals instead of or with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow with the hand pointing upward, it means the driver plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to tell drivers that left-turning vehicles do not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make space for vehicles that are merging in. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic enter safely.
